title: Valerie Ransone runs the Whip Inflation Now program in the Ford White House

tellings.quote: Well, when I knew her, she was working in the Gerald Ford White House.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a PhD who studies psychic phenomena, told Jesse Michels that when he knew a woman named Valerie Ransone, she was working in President Gerald Ford's White House in the mid 1970s. According to him, she ran Whip Inflation Now, a government campaign urging Americans to help fight rising prices. He tells it as background on someone he knew personally.
